start.howIntro: First, we want to understand the company: what it does, its sector and markets, its strengths and what sets it apart. Then, the project it intends to finance and the use of proceeds. In a few lines, in your own words. If an institutional presentation already exists, simply attach it.
start.howAnalysis: Share whatever is available: business plan, financial statements, contracts, accounting records or corporate documents. PDF, Excel or photo, exactly as they are. Offroad reads everything to understand how the company operates, its financial dynamics and the intended transaction. We reconcile sources so every statement has documentary support, flag discrepancies and identify points that require clarification. We also anticipate what investors will require, including for a preliminary assessment, so material issues do not surface only midway through the process.
start.howMarket: From there, we propose structures aligned with the transaction and prepare a complete information package, including a teaser, financial projections and an indicative term sheet, in the format the market expects. We understand financing products and maintain relationships with a broad base of capital providers. We know what each one reviews, how they review it and what they require for approval. This direction increases the transaction's probability of success. The introduction is conducted through the platform, with your authorization and only to investors whose mandates are aligned.

review.title: We analysed what you provided.
review.body: Below are the financial reading, identified discrepancies and the questions that materially change the case. Send what is missing and we will update only the affected parts.
review.nextBatchTitle: What we need to confirm now
review.nextBatchBody: Each request below comes from an analysis gap and explains what it unlocks. You may answer, attach documents or explain why an item does not apply.
review.nextBatchUploadBody: Drop the files as they are. They will be classified, reconciled and linked to the corresponding questions.
review.reanalyzeBody: We will verify coverage, reconcile the new sources and update the diagnosis without rereading what did not change.
review.issuesBody: These items were not resolved automatically.
review.emptyTitle: Your documents are safe, but no fields were proposed
review.emptyBody: This set was not yet sufficient to propose information safely. No data was invented. Add other files or process it again.
review.notReadyTitle: We will not compile the case yet
review.notReadyBody: Material points remain open. Answer or send the next round above; once the basis is sufficient, we will release the case compilation for your review.
review.caseReviewTitle: Read, question and correct it before approving.
review.caseReviewBody: The file below is the working version of the case, with figures, assumptions, discrepancies and sources. If anything is wrong or poorly explained, state exactly what must change; Offroad will rerun the analysis and present a new version.
review.revisionLabel: What is wrong, incomplete or poorly explained?
review.revisionPlaceholder: Example: the expansion does not start in January; the correct schedule is in the contract sent yesterday. 2025 revenue must also exclude the discontinued operation.
review.revisionBoundary: Your comment guides the new analysis, but it does not replace documentary evidence or change reconciled calculations without support.
review.revisionSubmit: Review and generate a new version
review.confirmTitle: Approve the case and review structures
review.confirmBody: The diagnosis and case above were compiled from the confirmed information. The next step compares suitable structures and explains each choice.
review.confirmDeclaration: I reviewed the case above and confirm that it accurately represents the company, its capital need and the material points known so far.

issues.hashMismatchBody: The SHA-256 computed on the server differs from the one reported by the browser at upload. The file was preserved and the verified hash is now authoritative.
issues.hashMismatchHint: If this is not the expected file, remove it and upload it again.

operation.title: Choose the primary objective
operation.body: If there is more than one objective, choose the most important one now. You can explain the others in the next step.
operation.clientBody: Identify the company in this case and record the basis of your authority. This declaration opens case preparation only. Evidence and additional permissions remain separate.
operation.authorityConfirmation: I confirm that my organization is authorized by the company to prepare this case.
operation.authorityStatus: This declaration does not authorize market sounding or investor introductions.
operation.continueNote: This choice only personalizes the next questions. The structure will be developed after the analysis.
operation.growth_expansionBody: New locations, capacity, products or market entry.
operation.working_capitalBody: Finance inventory, receivables or the operating cycle.
operation.refinanceBody: Reshape maturities, cost or the profile of existing debt.
operation.acquisitionBody: Finance the purchase of a company or strategic asset.
operation.equipment_financeBody: Acquire machinery, vehicles or other productive assets.
operation.venture_debtBody: Extend runway or fund growth without an immediate equity round.
operation.otherBody: Describe an objective that does not fit the options above.

checklist.idealTitle: Ideal to structure it and take it to market
checklist.emptyBody: Choose the operation above so the desk can build the list of what it needs.
checklist.unmatched: {count} uploaded document(s) match no item on the list. The desk reads them anyway.
checklist.informationTitle: Information about the company and the operation
checklist.frame: {count} items for now. This is not a data room: it is enough for us to build your case and take it to investors. The rest comes later, and it is listed below so you can see the whole road from the start.
checklist.stageNowBody: What we need to analyse the transaction, build the numbers, and prepare the material that goes to market.
checklist.stageDiligenceBody: None of this is being asked for now. It is listed because the moment a lender starts diligence it will ask for these, and it is better to know today than to find out in week three. Send anything you already have; otherwise carry on.
checklist.stageClosingBody: Not your task and not for today. These are the legal and registry steps at closing, largely run by the lawyers. They are here only so the road is visible end to end.
checklist.response_not_applicable: Does not apply to my company
checklist.response_partial: I have part of it, the rest is coming
checklist.response_after_nda: I will send it after the NDA
checklist.response_unavailable: I do not have this information or document
checklist.notePlaceholder: e.g. we sell for cash only, there is no receivables book.
checklist.requestKicker: INFORMATION LIST ADAPTED TO THE TRANSACTION
checklist.requestTitle: Send what you have. We will show the next step.
checklist.requestBody: We read first and ask second. This batch has {count} material items, with no repetition and no requirement to organize a data room before the analysis.
checklist.currentBatchBody: A short batch selected after considering everything already received. Send it in the format you have.
checklist.currentBatchEmpty: Everything needed at this point has already been found. Process the documents so we can move forward.
checklist.resolvedTitle: {count} items already found in the documents
checklist.roadmapTitle: The rest appears at the right time
checklist.roadmapBody: The complete playbook remains active behind the scenes. Diligence and closing never become tasks now.
checklist.recommendedBody: Information that makes the analysis more consistent and reduces follow-up questions.
checklist.minimumBody: The essential set for understanding the company, the request and starting the analysis.
checklist.idealBody: Materials that deepen the case and better prepare the company for diligence.
checklist.viewGuidance: See what you can send and why it matters
checklist.tierEmpty: No additional item at this level for this transaction.

case.receivablesBody: Offroad reconstructs the portfolio from the delivered files, computes traceable metrics and separates what is supported from what still needs clarification.
case.receivablesFindings: What we identified in the files
case.receivablesNoFindings: No material inconsistency was identified by the available controls.
case.receivablesNextBatchBody: After reading everything received, we select no more than five requests that most advance the analysis. This batch has {count}.
case.receivablesBatchComplete: There is no new request at this point.
case.receivablesAmountBody: The documents have been read. Enter the requested amount so we can compare the portfolio with the available structuring alternatives.
case.receivablesCoverage: {delivered} sources received and {searched} sources checked in this run.
case.briefBlocked: The summary was not produced because not every sentence could be traced to a fact. That is protection, not an error: nothing leaves here carrying a number that does not hold up.
case.materialsBlocked: Materials are not compiled while a critical point is open.
case.materialTruthBody: The teaser, memorandum, indicative term sheet, Q&A, model and room are compiled from the same governed basis and measured by all 32 material procedures.
case.empty: No analysis yet: process the documents first.
case.modelWhat: A spreadsheet with live formulas: operating projection, debt schedule, DSCR and leverage against the playbook's ceiling. Every editable cell is on the Assumptions sheet, so change one and the whole model recalculates. Every historical number is traced to its source document.
case.modelBlocked: The model needs at least one reconciled number. Upload the financial statements and it becomes available.
case.briefInProgress: The written case is being prepared right now. The numbers, exceptions and structure below are ready; refresh in a moment to read the text.
case.marketTruthBody: The transaction is screened against dated mandates using objective filters. The shortlist has an explicit rationale, never a magic percentage. The product ends at an authorised introduction to the right people.
case.marketReadyBody: Recipients, contacts, rationale and materials are tied to the versions authorised by the company.
case.marketPendingTitle: Investor contact is not authorised yet
case.marketPendingBody: The analysis may indicate alignment, but nobody receives materials before a current mandate, consistent package, named-recipient plan and company authorisation are all in place.
case.financialTruthBody: Reconciled statements, explicit adjustments, cash conversion and accounting identities. No gap becomes a silent estimate.
case.financialTruthEmpty: There is no structured financial statement yet.
case.debtTruthBody: Each instrument, obligation, security and covenant remains separate and traceable to its source.
case.debtTruthEmpty: There are not enough instruments to build the ledger yet.
case.operationTruthBody: The request is compared with calculated need. Sources, uses, working capital, costs, draws and the pro forma position remain tied and traceable.
case.structureTruthBody: Amount, tenor, repayment, security and covenants are tested against capacity, downside, existing obligations and day-one compatibility. Offroad proposes the structure without committing capital or replacing lender diligence.
case.pricingTruthBody: A range is only published when comparable, current, authorized and traceable observations meet house policy. The reference is indicative and does not represent a firm offer, capital commitment, credit decision or replacement for lender diligence.
case.pricingAbstentionTitle: No reliable reference for this cell
case.pricingAbstentionBody: The available sample does not yet meet comparability, freshness, independence and dispersion criteria. No range was estimated or filled by approximation.

brief.title: Tell us about the transaction
brief.body: Complete only what you know. If it is already in the materials, leave the fields blank and upload the files below.
brief.continueNote: Text and documents are equivalent inputs. We will extract what is in the files, research the company and sector, and show the preliminary understanding for your confirmation.
brief.uploadTitle: Does a project or financing document already exist?
brief.uploadBody: It can be a budget, business plan, schedule, contract, presentation or any file that explains the need. If the materials already contain the transaction, you do not need to repeat it in the fields above.
brief.uploadDropTitle: Upload whatever already exists about the transaction
brief.uploadDropBody: Drag files here or select them from your computer. Offroad will read and organize them later.
brief.objectiveLabel: What the company intends to accomplish
brief.objectiveHint: Describe the plan in plain language. You do not need to know the financing structure.
brief.objectivePlaceholder: Open three stores, expand the plant, refinance maturities or complete an acquisition.
brief.advancedBody: Optional. Complete only what is already defined. Offroad will develop and compare alternatives after the analysis.
brief.amountLabel: How much the company needs to raise
brief.amountHint: Write it however you like: 45,000,000 or 45 million.
brief.urgencyLabel: When the capital needs to be available
brief.urgencyHint: An approximate timeframe is enough to organize the process.
brief.termHint: How long the company needs to repay.
brief.graceHint: How long before amortisation starts. Optional.
brief.consequenceHint: Explain what the company gains by executing the plan and what changes if it is delayed.
brief.consequencePlaceholder: The investment adds capacity before the next commercial cycle and protects contracts already identified.
brief.sectorHint: In a word or two, how the company would describe itself.
brief.geographyHint: The two-letter state code. BR if national.
brief.collateralHint: Tick what exists today. Security rarely decides who lends on its own, but it moves price and structure a great deal.
brief.collateralNote_recebiveis: trade receivables, card, payer contracts, work billed
brief.collateralNote_imovel: owned by the company, the shareholders or the holding
brief.collateralNote_estoque: goods that turn, with proper control
brief.collateralNote_aval_fianca: personal guarantee, asked for almost always
brief.collateralNote_cessao_fiduciaria: collections land in an account that secures the debt
brief.collateralNote_conta_reserva: cash locked up, worth a few instalments
brief.instrumentLabel: Instrument, only if you already have a preference
brief.instrumentHint: If you do not know, leave it blank: that part is ours. And blank is better early, because in Brazil the instrument decides which vehicles may hold the paper, and ticking one now removes funds that would have said yes.
brief.instrumentNote_debenture: for a corporation; reaches funds and investors
brief.instrumentNote_nota_comercial: simpler than a debênture, for corporations and limitadas
brief.instrumentNote_ccb: bank credit note; the most direct route
brief.instrumentNote_cri: when the credit has real-estate backing
brief.instrumentNote_cra: when the credit has agribusiness backing
brief.instrumentNote_direct_loan: a bilateral contract with the lender
brief.instrumentNote_project_finance: the project repays and answers for the debt
brief.rateHint: However you think about it: 13% a year, CDI + 4, 1.2% a month. If you have no idea, leave it blank. The lender sets the price, and our read on what the market has been paying for this profile comes back to you after the analysis.

desk.title: Credit desk
desk.assumptions: CDI at {cdi}, reference date {date}. Arithmetic over reconciled facts; the narrative may rephrase these numbers, it may not renumber them.
desk.trajectoryAssumptions: Stressed case: projected growth cut by {haircut}, audited base preserved. Proposed covenant sits {cushion} above the stressed case.
desk.lmBody: The transaction takes out {lenders} ({balance}), the only covenanted lines, leaving {newMoney} of new money. Leverage after the swap: {leverage}.
desk.questionsBody: In meeting order. Each question comes from a reading above; none is generic.
desk.missingSomeTitle: What is still missing to close the analysis
desk.missingSomeBody: The desk ran with what there was. These fields would sharpen the reading.
desk.missingAllBody: The fields below are missing. Send the document that carries each one and the analysis is assembled automatically.
desk.lmBodyRefinancing: The raise repays {balance} of existing debt at disbursement (a liability swap), leaving {newMoney} of new money. Leverage after the swap: {leverage}.
